overall_notes: The paper focuses on instructive dialogue summarization using instruction-tuned models. The extracted metadata was generally accurate but needed normalization of dataset names (SAMSum vs SAM-Sum) and model naming consistency. The paper uses both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BERTScore) and both human and LLM (ChatGPT) evaluation on the same four criteria. The NLG task is clearly dialogue summarization with query-conditioned and length-controlled variants.
